title: Evaluation Report v1
description: Companion schema for spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 2. The root schema validates an Evaluation Report record: per-case met/not_met/not_evaluable judgments over cited acts, reached under one judge pin. This is the single-party case of adjudication-v1.json's shape -- each Case's basis reuses that schema's Basis $def field-for-field (model_id, prompt_digest, axes_digest, sampling), so 'judgment-basis fields identical across both' is a literal, not just a stated, property of this family. Unifies capsule-judge's judge_judgment/judge_adjudication and capsule-compiler's judge_judgment_adapter row convention into one schema. epistemic_type is fixed to semantic_judgment -- a judgment reached by interpretation, not direct observation.

MethodCitation.description: The rubric or method this case was judged against -- cited by digest, never inlined, so a reader can independently resolve exactly what standard produced the verdict.

ContractRef.description: Compact versioned Evidence Contract reference: <contract_id>@<version>. Same convention as evidence-result-v0.json's Claim.contract_ref.

Basis.description: Identical in name and meaning to adjudication-v1.json's Basis $def -- the shared judgment-basis shape this family reuses rather than redefines.

Case.description: The single-party adjudication: one case, judged under this report's judge_pin, against cited acts and a cited method, resolving to the Evidence Contract's three-value Verdict (v3 section 8, mirrored here, never redefined -- same vocabulary evidence-result-v0.json's Claim.verdict uses).
